changes: Approval icons follow the selected policy; standalone Appearance sidebar toggle removed
Grouped Settings navigation, dropdown theme library and editable palette controls
Data-only theme import/copy/export/removal; Graphite rename, Tokyo, Paper, and new AG1 Midnight palette
Chat Delete moves to explicit restorable Trash; native discovery merges preserve deleted and renamed metadata
Selected-model reasoning menu with server/provider capability-backed toggles or discrete levels
Native selection revalidation and model-bound durable effort mapping, including off/none, native casing, xhigh and max preservation
Plugins library with search/categories and separate package, skill creation and advanced views; imported desktop themes appear in the library
Subtle configurable Plan-mode outline and tighter menu/panel spacing; private visual checks

native_ui.scope: Private Xvfb, native Tauri/WebKit, isolated fake streaming provider; no user window or real model touched.
native_ui.note: The native minimum size clamps the requested 640-wide resize; screenshot dimensions are recorded instead of claiming a 640px viewport.

installed_launcher.scope: Private Xvfb, native Tauri/WebKit, isolated fake streaming provider; no user window or real model touched.

limitations: Not a new P14 performance acceptance; neither 8h nor 24h workload started
Reasoning levels are unavailable when a backend does not expose or declare an enumerable capability profile; cold local models may require refreshing after load
Llama discovery is read-only and checks exact single-model identity; authenticated endpoints need declared provider metadata; no generic provider API can be assumed to advertise effort enums
Visual inference used isolated fixture providers only; no real GPU inference or user-display interaction added
Delete is restorable Trash; journals and shared artifacts are retained
Theme plugins are downloadable/importable JSON palettes, not a public marketplace; exports go into private desktop state/theme-exports
Older releases may ignore new theme preferences or Trash metadata during software rollback
